command_options.description: List of command-line options to pass to bluefish on startup (e.g., ['-c', '--curwindow']). Each item must be a valid bluefish(1) option string. Only supports -c/--curwindow or -n/--newwindow for window behavior override; help/version flags are not recommended in non-interactive contexts. Empty list means no extra options beyond executable name (uses default behavior).
